Below is a simple diagram outlining how the physiotherapy department receives internet service.

This modem provides an open network that is fully separated from the Glencoe network. From this connection, internet service is supplied to Physiotherapy, the golf simulator, the parking server, and the plant panel located in the main utility room. There is no Wi-Fi being broadcast from this network.

As previously mentioned, if this system experiences an electrical failure, all of the services listed above will lose internet access. Because this is an isolated network, it cannot be monitored or managed through our Meraki console.
Note: All this equipment can be found in a brown cabinet in the Squash area.
